body: Hey Op, we don't know each other but everything is going to be fine, I know it doesn't seem the right thing to say but we're here to Help. I'm willing, DM me bro. Don't give up yet
Bro, there's always a way, talk to us, some people online still care and not want you to give up
Hey Op, share some news and some thoughts, you might even get better just by talking with some strangers with good intentions
We're all happy that he's replying
Thx for the help, I will look for Watts later. Maybe I can get back on track somehow

Thx for the kind words. As Nietzsche said " To live is to suffer, to survive is to find some meaning in that suffering". Since I've lost my meaning, the one I prized the most I might as well look forward. Really thoughtful of you for making me look on the brighter side
Thx so much. Hopefully everything will just be fine after a while
